title: Anyone can skin the surface.
titleAccent: We engineer every layer beneath it.
subtitle: Interface to infrastructure. One accountable engineer. Full source ownership.

intro.dismissed: Most agencies deliver the top layer — a template with a brand coat, rented and opaque beneath.

closing: You own the domain — and everything under it.

interface.name: Interface
interface.detail: Designed from the buyer's actual flow — first scroll to final action — not from a theme's demo content. Pixel-precise, WCAG AA, RTL-native, sub-second on mobile.
interface.ownership: A real interface built for your business — not a shell with your logo dropped in.

components.name: Components
components.detail: A composable, state-driven UI system on design tokens. Every element is reused, not rebuilt — so the site holds its standard as it grows.
components.ownership: A design system your team can extend — not a one-off Figma file that drifts on the first edit.

application.name: Application
application.spec: The logic that runs the business
application.detail: Server components, business rules, authentication, and APIs — type-safe end to end. Your workflows, engineered to your logic.
application.ownership: Custom logic shaped to how you operate — not a plugin's assumptions bent to fit.

data.name: Data
data.detail: A modeled PostgreSQL schema built for integrity and growth. Structured, queryable, and documented — the foundation the rest of the system stands on.
data.ownership: A database you fully own and can migrate — not a black-box CMS table you rent.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure
infrastructure.detail: Edge deployment, monitoring, and automated backups on infrastructure you control. Fast everywhere, observable, and recoverable.
infrastructure.ownership: Deployment you hold the keys to — no vendor lock-in, no subscription holding your site hostage.
